{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011Ch5N1pZzU1itxJQh55UsC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I fixed the damage on manual takeoff from a ground-station pad, but I haven't run the game to confirm it. The change compiles cleanly; I didn't reproduce the recorded takeoff to check the hull readout.\n\n**What the video shows:** the player's ship is sitting on a pad of a surface station on Mars. It launches in manual \"fixspeed\" mode (no autopilot), meant to rise at 2 m/s. The hull readout drops from 100% to 99% the moment the takeoff starts.\n\n**Cause:** when a ship launches manually, the station gives up the pad reservation straight away. On the first physics step the ship is still touching its own pad. The station's collision handler then sees a ship touching a pad that isn't reserved for it and applies collision damage. The takeoff code (`Player::DoFixspeedTakeoff` in `src/Player.cpp`) already guards against this by lifting the ship 1 cm and giving it a small upward push, but only for orbital stations. Ground stations were left out.\n\n**Fix (`src/Player.cpp`, `Player::DoFixspeedTakeoff`):** the 1 cm lift and the 0.05 m/s upward velocity now apply to every station takeoff, so the ship starts clear of the pad. That covers any pad on any surface station. The orbital-only steps (following the station's rotation and matching its spin) are unchanged, as are autopilot launches and takeoffs from open ground with no station.\n\nBy my estimate, gravity takes at most about 1.5 mm off that 1 cm in the first step, before the thrusters take over. I haven't checked that in-game."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2152,"cache_read_input_tokens":34683,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2152,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":7,"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"aca1973e-5c80-4d07-a74f-eb012b4154ee","uuid":"d8adf00e-df21-4d72-9de6-4b59625aae1f","timestamp":"2026-11-15T20:42:28.447Z"}
